title: Design System: tegakko — The Morning Writing Desk

seededFrom.name: The Morning Writing Desk
seededFrom.source: User-selected grounded direction; code-led direction round

display.purpose: Brand wordmark and prominent readouts, sized by their component styles.

heading.purpose: Screen titles, section headings, prompts, and action labels.

body.purpose: Explanations, helper text, and descriptive control content.

label.purpose: Group labels and compact status text.

glyph-ink.purpose: Authentic Japanese graphemes in reference and missed-glyph summaries only.

shadows.name: grade-feedback
shadows.purpose: Separates the transient peach grade toast from the writing surface.

shadows.name: import-confirmation
shadows.purpose: Separates the blocking Settings import dialog from the page.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Calm transitions between selected and unselected states.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Primary action for starting or continuing a practice flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 88px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-on-paper); font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--motion-press), transform var(--motion-press); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-strong); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-mark); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Quiet action with a paper edge, used for secondary choices and controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 88px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--color-paper-line); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-heading); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--motion-press), transform var(--motion-press); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-paper-warm); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-mark); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Shared deep-green header with brand, screen context, and available navigation actions; History and Settings return to their originating Scope or Summary screen.
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 76px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 10px 24px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-on-paper); } .ds-nav strong { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav button { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: rgba(251, 246, 235, 0.12); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-mark); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Paper Sheet
components.description: Responsive content sheet framed by the warm desk ground.
components.html:
Today's scope

What would you like to write?
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; width: min(100%, 880px); margin: auto; padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px) clamp(22px, 5vw, 52px); border: 1px solid var(--color-paper-line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-bookmark { position: absolute; top: -1px; right: 24px; padding: 9px 14px 11px; border-radius: 0 0 5px 5px; background: var(--color-mark); color: var(--color-accent-on-paper); font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Selected Scope Option
components.description: Selected writing-system or group control, shown with a green fill and paper text.
components.css: .ds-option { min-height: 62px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-on-paper); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: rgba(251, 246, 235, .86); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-mark); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Positive state paired with readable status text.
components.css: .ds-chip-positive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 13px; background: var(--color-positive-bg); color: var(--color-positive-fg); font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .02em; }

components.name: Blank Recall Canvas
components.description: Paper writing surface with faint center guides and no reference glyph or decoration.
components.css: .ds-canvas { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid var(--color-paper-line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-surface-canvas); touch-action: none; } .ds-canvas::before, .ds-canvas::after { position: absolute; content: ''; pointer-events: none; background: var(--color-grid-guide); opacity: .8; } .ds-canvas::before { top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 50%; width: 1px; } .ds-canvas::after { top: 50%; right: 0; left: 0; height: 1px; }

components.name: Grade Feedback Toast
components.description: Transient peach feedback with miss context and a time-bounded Undo action.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-missed-bg); color: var(--color-missed-fg); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(46, 43, 37, .18); } .ds-toast button { min-height: 48px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-accent-strong); font-family: var(--font-heading); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toast button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-mark); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a clear, well-kept writing desk for a quiet practice ritual. Warm paper sheets sit against a darker desk ground; deep green organizes the interface and terracotta acts as a small bookmark-like mark. Familiar controls stay legible and direct, while a restrained sheet frame gives secondary screens a sense of place.

The Drill screen brings the prompt and blank writing cell forward. The cell remains a working surface: no texture or decoration enters it. Japanese glyphs can use the expressive Yuji Syuku face where they are actual graphemes; labels, readings, explanations, and actions remain easy to read.
keyCharacteristics: Desk and paper: warm desk ground, pale paper sheets, and quiet paper-line borders.
Green structure: deep green anchors navigation and selected or primary actions.
Terracotta marker: terracotta identifies the active page bookmark and selected accuracy emphasis.
Recall first: the writing canvas stays blank apart from its faint center guides.

rules.name: The Blank Recall Rule
rules.body: Keep the active writing canvas free of reference glyphs, texture, and ornament; comparison appears only after the learner chooses Reveal.

rules.name: The Glyph Boundary Rule
rules.body: Yuji Syuku is reserved for actual Japanese graphemes, never romaji, English meanings, readings, labels, or button text.

dos: Do use the actual CSS custom properties in src/app/theme.css as the color source of truth.
Do keep deep green for primary structure and actions, terracotta for bookmark and selected emphasis, and warm paper for the sheet surfaces.
Do keep the writing area blank during recall and show references separately after Reveal.
Do preserve the existing self-grading, Undo, sampling, backup, and accessible status-announcement behavior when changing screens.
Do reserve Yuji Syuku for actual Japanese glyphs.
Do keep status meaning legible in text as well as color and preserve visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't bring back the previous persimmon-only palette or warm cream full-viewport ground; the implemented system uses green structure and paper sheets on a desk ground.
Don't add texture or decoration to the active writing cell.
Don't turn the experience into a generic card dashboard or decorative notebook scene.
Don't add streaks, pressure notifications, cloud accounts, tracking, or new learning claims.
Don't use Yuji Syuku for romaji, English copy, readings, labels, or controls.
